title: The unopened letter, v
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Saturday. The envelope under the table leg, on top of the two from 2007. The table is now perfectly level for the first time since 2004. That's the strip's whole answer.

panels.composition: WOOD kneeling at the drafting table's short leg. The two 2007 letters already there, yellowed. The new envelope in his hand.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man kneeling at a drafting table's leg where two yellowed folded letters are already wedged, holding a new unopened envelope

panels.composition: The envelope sliding in, on top. Three shims.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of an unopened envelope being slid under a table leg on top of two older folded letters

panels.composition: The coffee on the table. Perfectly still. A level, borrowed from Gully, on the table: the bubble dead center.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a spirit level on a drafting table with its bubble dead center beside a mug of perfectly still coffee, no words

panels.composition: Wood drawing at the level table. The pup asleep beneath with his chin on the shims. Fourteen years of wobble, fixed by not opening things.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man drawing at a drafting table while a small three-legged dog sleeps beneath it with its chin resting on three folded letters under one leg, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Third shim. The table level at last. The answer.
